answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the marble is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The inlet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the sable is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
